MammoLingo explains selected mammogram-report terms in plain language. It cannot interpret your report, diagnose a condition, assess your risk, recommend a test or follow-up plan, or replace a clinician. Discuss your results, symptoms, and circumstances with a qualified clinician. For urgent symptoms or an emergency, seek local emergency care.
